title: Why Coffee Actually Wakes You Up (The Science)
topic: Why Coffee Makes You Alert: The Science Explained
script: Ever wonder why coffee makes you feel superhuman? It all starts with a molecule called adenosine. Throughout the day, adenosine builds up in your brain, telling you it is time to sleep. But caffeine is a master of disguise. It mimics adenosine and wedges itself into your brain's receptors, blocking the 'sleepy' signals. Your brain stays alert, your focus sharpens, and you are ready to conquer the day. That is the science of your morning brew.
